tabProjectsDesc: Manage your registered projects. Each card shows processing, verification and confirmation at a glance. On a PC, the selected project's stage board opens on the right.
addProjectDesc: Press this button to connect a GitHub/GitLab repository. Import one from the account you signed in with, or enter a URL and token directly.
addProjectEmptyDesc: No projects yet! Tap this button to connect a GitHub/GitLab repository.
projectStatsDesc: Shows processing, verification and confirmation (in progress, ←waiting), done today, and work to merge (open MRs). Press a number to expand that stage's list.
projectScannerDesc: Pause or resume automatic task detection.
tabAgentsDesc: See AI agents and people (Git members) together by processing, verification and confirmation roles.
agentsFilterDesc: View by role: All, Process, Verify, Confirm. The cyan number is the work piled up for that role (waiting + in progress).
addAgentDesc: Register a new AI agent. Pick a CLI tool (Claude Code, agy, Codex CLI or OpenCode, as allowed) and a model, and give it a name. Roles are given in the project's role roster.
addAgentEmptyDesc: No agents yet! Tap this button to register an AI agent.
agentCardDesc: Shows the agent's status (idle, working, offline), CLI and model, and roles. The power button pauses or resumes it.
agentStatsDesc: Shows in progress, done today, failed and waiting counts. 'Stats' shows performance over the last 20 tasks.
agentInterviewDesc: Chat with the agent directly. Ask about its work approach or configuration.
agentTestDesc: Test whether the CLI is properly installed and responding.
tabIssuesDesc: Register tasks and move them through processing → verification → confirmation → done while watching progress. On a PC, the list is on the left and details on the right.
issuesProjectSelectDesc: First, choose the project to view tasks for. Auto-selected if only one project exists.
addIssueDesc: Register a new task. The first line is the title and the rest is the body. You can also set priority, due date and assignees.
issuesFilterDesc: Split into All, Waiting, In progress, Failed, Done and History (closed tasks), with search, 'Mine' and sorting.
tabReportsDesc: See the work you are holding, work finished, where the time went, and hours and cost spent, by period.
reportsPeriodDesc: Choose weekly, monthly or yearly and use the arrows to move between periods. The project filter above lets you pick only the projects you want.
tabAdminDesc: Admins only. Manage user permissions, report mail, and system settings such as CLI paths, mail, OAuth and rates.
adminSubTabsDesc: Move between Users, Outreach, Settings and Logs.
